caption: Each message bit replaces bit 0 of one pixel, so only 150 changes (to 151); the squared errors are 1, 0, 0. With MSE = 1/3 ≈ 0.333, PSNR = 10 log₁₀(255² ÷ 1/3) ≈ 52.9 dB.

spec.title: LSB embedding of bits 1, 0, 1
spec.aria: A five-row table over three pixels: original values 150, 152, 155, their bit 0 values 0, 0, 1, the message bits 1, 0, 1, the new values 151, 152, 155, and squared errors 1, 0, 0, with the changed pixel 151 and its error 1 highlighted.
